source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas

morphology_documented.leaves: Alternate simple evergreen; flowering branch blades oblong-lanceolate to oblong-elliptic, abruptly narrowed or rounded-truncate at base, glabrous below; to 55 × 28 mm; petioles 1–3 mm
morphology_documented.fruit: Bright red drupaceous fruits to approximately 6.5 mm diameter
morphology_documented.habitat: Low woods and sandy areas; often cultivated

source_scope_note: Genus-level traits are expressly indicated; absent species details not inferred.
